description: Cloudflare Ultra Advanced SEO & Security Ruleset for Paranjape Blue Ridge

cache_rules.name: Sovereign Edge Cache Everything (PSEO & Static)
cache_rules.description: Caches all HTML, sitemaps, feeds and assets globally with 30-day edge TTL, bypassing on admin vault session.
cache_rules.expression: (http.host eq "paranjapeblueridge.com") and not (http.request.uri.path contains "/sovereign-vault") and not (http.request.uri.path contains "/api/")

cache_rules.name: Bypass Cache for Admin Sovereign Vault & APIs

transform_rules.name: Edge SEO Trailing Slash & Lowercase Normalization
transform_rules.description: Strips trailing slashes and forces lowercase paths for pristine canonical indexing.

transform_rules.name: Strip Marketing Query Parameters for Cache Hits
transform_rules.description: Removes fbclid, gclid, and utm parameters before cache lookup while preserving analytics logging.

waf_rules.name: Crawl Budget Defense: Block Unverified Bad Bots
waf_rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "AhrefsBot" or http.user_agent contains "SemrushBot" or http.user_agent contains "DotBot" or http.user_agent contains "MJ12bot") and not cf.client.bot

waf_rules.name: Whitelist Verified Search Engine Bots
waf_rules.expression: cf.client.bot and (http.user_agent contains "Googlebot" or http.user_agent contains "Bingbot" or http.user_agent contains "DuckDuckBot" or http.user_agent contains "YandexBot")
